extraction.title: FEATURE: per-topic unsubscribe option in emails
extraction.head: topic-email-management

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as a per-topic unsubscribe feature. Backend: a new unsubscribe action in TopicsController that toggles notification levels between regular and muted, new routes, an unsubscribe_url method on Topic, and mailer and template changes. Frontend: new Ember route, controller, view, and template. Confidence score of 2/5, says the PR is unsafe to merge as is.
"syntax: Typo: 'stopNotificiationsText' should be 'stopNotificationsText' (missing 'a' in 'Notifications')". Suggests renaming the function to stopNotificationsText.
"syntax: Typo in property name: 'stopNotificiationsText' should be 'stopNotificationsText' (missing 'n' in 'Notifications')". Suggests correcting the template's property reference.
Flags a possible nil pointer error: if no TopicUser record is found, tu is nil and later calls will crash. Suggests returning a 404 JSON error when tu is missing.
Raises a logic concern that email unsubscribe links usually work without login, but the new unsubscribe action is added to the authenticated actions list. Paraphrased; no code change suggested.
"syntax: CSS selector syntax error: '.previous-discussion' should not have a leading dot in the class attribute". Suggests changing class='.previous-discussion' to class='previous-discussion'.
